text:
Mira H: Follow-up from the INC-2052 postmortem: recurring KV warm misses during traffic spikes. We need concise runbook edits, owners for the short-term mitigations, and a tracked remediation plan. Please volunteer for sections.

Devon P: I can draft a tight "first 5 minutes" playbook: what to check, safe commands, and a non-destructive sanity check before any flush. ETA 48h.

Sam (SRE): I'll handle escalation windows and alert tuning. Proposal: page primary if p95 > 2s for 3m; escalate after 4m no-ack. I'll open a Jira and link it here.

Devon P: Commands I'll put in the playbook:
```
# check recent kv errors
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-runtime --since=5m | grep -i kv_cache
# kv warm metric on pod
kubectl -n inference exec $POD -- curl -fs localhost:9100/metrics | grep kv_hit_rate
```
Include a note: prefer scale-up before flush to avoid cold-start cascade.

Mira H: We also need a remediation owner for the config change (auto-lower batch_size when cold_start_rate spikes). Who can own testing + staging rollout?

Test Rex: I can take the config tests. I will add a staging smoke that injects a short burst and asserts kv_hit_rate >= 90% within 30s. ETA 10 days.

infra-bot: Reminder: update INC-2052 follow-ups in tracker by 2026-04-12.

Mira H: Action summary here so tracker matches:
- Playbook: Devon P — due 2026-04-08, PR to runbooks.
- Alerts/escalation: Sam (SRE) — due 2026-04-06, ticket INC-2052-ESCL.
- Config tests + staging smoke: Test Rex — due 2026-04-18.

Sam (SRE): Ticket opened: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2052-ESCL — added paging messages and ack windows.

Devon P: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/inference/runbooks/pulls/137 — includes checklist and commands. Feedback welcome.

Mira H: Thanks all. Keep thread updated with PRs/ticket links and testing notes. We'll close the follow-ups once the tracker shows merged PRs and green smoke runs. :white_check_mark:
